BASELINE_GRID_RESTRICTED — grid_restricted

Baseline scenario with standard regulatory buffers around aeroways and conservation lands and a 50 km proximity filter for transmission connections; serves as a conservative reference case to evaluate the impact of grid connection constraints and land use restrictions on renewable energy siting potential in Canada; designed to reflect typical regulatory environments and provide a realistic baseline for comparison with more optimistic scenarios that relax certain constraints
